mapper.select: SELECT id, name, gender, admission_number, phone, create_time, update_time, is_deleted FROM patient WHERE is_deleted = 0 OR is_deleted IS NULL ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.gender, p.admission_number, p.phone, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.is_deleted FROM patient p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pd.patient_id, MIN(pd.doctor_id) AS doctor_id FROM patient_doctor pd INNER JOIN (SELECT patient_id, MIN(create_time) AS min_ct FROM patient_doctor GROUP BY patient_id) t ON pd.patient_id = t.patient_id AND pd.create_time = t.min_ct GROUP BY pd.patient_id ) cr ON p.id = cr.patient_id LEFT JOIN doctor creator ON cr.doctor_id = creator.id WHERE (p.is_deleted = 0 OR p.is_deleted IS NULL) AND (creator.id IS NULL OR creator.level != 0) ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
SELECT id, name, gender, admission_number, phone, create_time, update_time, is_deleted FROM patient WHERE id = #{id} AND (is_deleted = 0 OR is_deleted IS NULL)
SELECT id, name, gender, admission_number, phone, create_time, update_time, is_deleted FROM patient WHERE admission_number = #{admissionNumber} AND (is_deleted = 0 OR is_deleted IS NULL)

SELECT id, name, gender, admission_number, phone, create_time, update_time, is_deleted FROM patient WHERE (is_deleted = 0 OR is_deleted IS NULL) AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR admission_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY create_time DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patient (name, gender, admission_number, phone, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{name}, #{gender}, #{admissionNumber}, #{phone}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, 0)
